testcase.name: test_cod_order_can_progress_through_logistics

failure.message:
AssertionError: Order status did not advance to 'delivered' after PUT calls returned 200. Got 'confirmed'. Last PUT result: ('delivered', 200, '"delivered_at"'). Likely cause: @api_router.put('/orders/{order_id}/status') decorator in server.py is attached to helper `_status_timestamp_field` (line ~2250) instead of `update_order_status` (line ~2381). The route returns the timestamp-field name as JSON without touching MongoDB. assert 'confirmed' == 'delivered'
- delivered + confirmed
